name: Boon Of Poison Mastery
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Antitoxic
features.description: You have Immunity to Poison damage and the Poisoned condition.

features.name: Perfect Poisoner
features.description: Once per turn, when you roll dice to determine Poison damage a creature takes from your attack, spell, or feature, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die.
